final_rationale: The verdict changes because the Actor narrowed an overbroad certification posture to a policy-bounded, caveated one; no new admissible evidence was added. On the existing record, aggregate readiness and the absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support launch readiness in general, while policy and the unresolved merchant-dispute weakness support only a disclosed, caveated certification posture. That is enough for compliant_with_caveats because the caveat is the required compliance condition, not something cured by the draft runbook. A clean compliant verdict is not supported: the weakness remains, the mitigation is still incomplete, and the current model-card draft conflicts with the disclosure obligation.
remaining_concerns: There is still no admissible evidence of approved risk acceptance or of a finalized mitigation containing owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
The merchant dispute support weakness remains unresolved for a named launch use case, concentrated in chargeback evidence summarization.
The current model-card draft says there are no known material limitations, which is not supportable on the present record unless the merchant-dispute limitation is explicitly disclosed.
There is no admissible evidence showing the final model-card text actually includes the required disclosure.
